text:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: metrics-scrape-failure (svc=prometheus-scrape) for job="model-runtime-exporter" — missing series model_latency_seconds, scrape_errors > 5 in 2m. PD:PD-4567

jamal: Acked in PD and here. I'm oncall. Looking at the scrape errors now.

priya: Grafana shows no recent data for model_* panels since 03:12 UTC, looks like all replicas of model-runtime-exporter are returning 502.

alex: can you paste the prometheus scrape logs?

priya: Logs from prometheus-scraper-0 (truncated):
```
level=error ts=2026-04-12T03:12:14.123Z caller=scrape.go:789 module=main target=model-runtime-exporter/10.2.4.12:9100 msg="scrape failed" err="unexpected response code: 502"
level=warn ts=2026-04-12T03:12:15.456Z caller=manager.go:234 component=kubernetes_sd debug="failed to fetch pod endpoints: context deadline exceeded"
```

ops-bot: Running quick health checks: `kubectl get pods -n monitoring -l app=prometheus-scraper -o wide`

jamal: Results: 2/3 scraper pods Ready, one CrashLoopBackOff. Also seeing backlog on log-ingest-consumer: consumer lag ~12,400,000 messages per partition. That smells like downstream Kafka consumer stall.

infra-rotation: CrashLoop logs from scraper pod: `panic: dial tcp 10.2.4.12:9100: connect: connection refused` — exporter process not accepting connections. Could be OOM or stuck.

kate: If exporter is down, dashboards will show no metrics. Are there customer-facing impacts or just internal dashboards?

megan: We have a few customers complaining their Observability dashboards show blank panels and alerting triggers in their own tenants. API paths are unaffected (application traffic OK). This is limited to metrics/logging UI and alerting. Marking as customer-impacting for SLO.

jamal: Runbook step 1: attempt graceful restart of the exporter pod and check disk pressure. Command: `kubectl -n services rollout restart deployment model-runtime-exporter && kubectl -n monitoring logs -l app=prometheus-scraper --tail=200`

alex: I'm scaling the scraper to 3 replicas while we triage.
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring scale deployment prometheus-scraper --replicas=3
```

ops-bot: scale command accepted, new replica requested.

priya: After restart, one exporter pod failed due to OOMKilled. Looks like a memory leak in the exporter after a recent config change.

jamal: Next step: promote backup exporter endpoint (region-fallback) to live in the scrape job while we fix primary. Edit scrape config to add alternate target group with `preferred: false`? I'll patch autoscrape config to temporarily include model-runtime-exporter-eu.

megan: Good. I'll notify customers in the status page: "Observability metrics may be delayed/missing for some services; working on remediation."

PagerBot: Incident duration timer started (PD-4567). Escalation will occur in 10m if no resolution.

alex: Quick mitigation applied: patched Prometheus scrape config to include fallback target and reloaded Prometheus config.
```kubectl -n monitoring exec -it prometheus-0 -- /bin/promtool check config /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml && kubectl -n monitoring exec prometheus-0 -- kill -HUP 1
```

priya: After fallback, metrics started to arrive from EU exporter but with 60s scrape delay. Dashboards are back to >80% normal.

kate: Nice. We need root cause: memory leak in exporter after config X deployed at 02:58 UTC. Who owns that config?

infra-rotation: That config came from infra/exports PR #4125 — I can revert the change and redeploy.

jamal: Revert and redeploy plan: revert PR, redeploy exporter replicas, scale down scraper to stable counts, monitor for OOM. I'll run the revert now.

jamal: Revert applied, redeploy started. Watching pods...

ops-bot: New pods starting, health checks passing. No OOMs yet.

megan: PD incident updated: mitigation=temporary fallback + revert PR. Notifying affected customers and setting status to "degraded". :white_check_mark:

PagerBot: PD-4567: Incident acknowledged by jamal. Escalation canceled.

kate: Post-mitigation ask: please capture exact metrics that were missing for downstream incident postmortem and tag any customer impact windows.

jamal: Captured time window: 03:12:14 - 03:32:40 UTC. Missing series: model_latency_seconds, model_request_count. Logged customers affected: acct-1823, acct-2245 (reported dashboard blanks).

priya: I'll follow up with an alert tuning PR to reduce noise and add a runbook link to the scrape failure alert.

alex: Summary for handoff -> priya (night): fallback active, exporter PR reverted, prometheus fallback targets removed after stable check tomorrow 04:30 UTC, PD incident closed pending postmortem. If anything flaps, page SRE rotation.

priya: Taking over for nights. Thanks all. Leaving monitoring checks and alerts pinned.

oncall-james: Thanks team — paging down. Will open incident ticket in JIRA: SRE-8891 for RCA and follow-up ops work (increase exporter e2e tests, memory regression alerting).

infra-rotation: :thumbsup: Good catch.

jamal: closing thread — will add notes to PD and link JIRA.

ops-bot: Incident closed in PD (PD-4567) by jamal at 03:35:10 UTC.
